pullRequests.title: fix(port): Vulkan pipeline parts take only their own state; bindings only their own stages
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/vulkan-prewarm
pullRequests.body:
#216's pipeline-library linking built each shared part with the whole state of the first key that needed it. NVIDIA (GTX 1070, 580.178) carried the vertex input given to the shared output part into every pipeline linked from it, so draws with another vertex layout read the wrong vertices. llvmpipe ignores the extra state, which is why CI passed.
Six Vulkan tests failed on NVIDIA from #216 on: render_equivalence_vulkan, render_equivalence_vulkan_remaining, enhanced_rendering_vulkan,…

pullRequests.title: fix(rac2): Windows x64 crashes from calls typed in another argument order
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/rac2-windows-call-abi
pullRequests.body:
Going Commando ran on Linux and macOS but crashed on Windows: first in the title's menus, then in Aranos. Each crash was a call whose declared parameter order differs from the definition it reaches.
Cause: System V and AArch64, like the EE, pass integers and floats in separate registers, each kind in order. So f(float, void *) reaching f(void *, float) works there. On Windows x64 a position decides the register, so the callee reads a pointer from a float's bits. The crash addresses were float…
